hero.title: Central Tiffin Room: Serving Nostalgia Since 1920
hero.subtitle: Discover the authentic taste of Old Bengaluru with our iconic Dosas, Idlis, and timeless South Indian delicacies. A century of culinary excellence awaits you.

about.title: The Enduring Legacy of Central Tiffin Room
about.paragraph1: CTR, also known as Central Tiffin Rooms, is a legendary hotel steeped deeply in the hearts and history of Old Bengaluru. Incepted in 1920, we have been delighting patrons for over a century with our iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a variety of South Indian delicacies, which have remained timeless favorites among people of all ages.
about.paragraph2: Central Tiffin Room's rich legacy, crafted by the visionary Subramanyam brothers, Mr. Sanjeev Poojari to the current 3rd Generation baton carriers Mr. Sandesh Poojari and Ganesh S Poojari epitomizes culinary mastery and cherished tradition in all its glory. If there’s one thing that mirrors the brand, it is the sheer love of our patrons who have been our showring us with boundless love and support for the last 100+ years.
